# GKP Artistry & Makeovers — Luxury Bridal Makeup

> Mumbai-based luxury bridal makeup artist and educator, available worldwide for destination weddings and running a professional makeup academy.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Signature bridal artistry, services, and studio overview.
- [Portfolio](/portfolio): Filterable gallery of bridal, destination, engagement, reception, editorial and western work.
- [Academy](/academy): 5-Day Masterclass, 1-Day Look & Learn (city editions), and 2-Month Professional Course.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Bridal makeup packages, factors that influence pricing, and how to enquire.
